text: We are a manufacturer in Sydney looking to automate order processing, shop-floor data capture, and operations without replacing our ERP. Which automation and Power Platform consultants should we speak to?

result.keyword: We are a manufacturer in Sydney looking to automate order processing, shop-floor data capture, and operations without replacing our ERP. Which automation and Power Platform consultants should we speak to?

items.markdown:
When you want to layer agility, shop-floor visibility, and automated order processing on top of your existing ERP without undergoing a massive, risky rip-and-replace project, you need `specialists who understand both low-code orchestration and heavy industrial data integration`.

A curated list of Sydney-centric and Australian Microsoft Power Platform partners specializing in manufacturing operations includes:

- **Inturing** — A specialist Australian consultancy explicitly focused on AI automation and Power Platform integration for manufacturers, mining suppliers, and operations teams. They specialize in connecting existing ERPs and engineering software without replacing them, using Power Apps for shop-floor data capture, and AI document extraction to turn messy PDFs or emails into structured data. You can explore their approach on the [Inturing Manufacturing Solutions](https://www.inturing.com.au/manufacturing) page.[[1]](https://inturing.com.au/)[[2]](https://www.inturing.com.au/manufacturing)
- **Barhead Solutions** — A prominent Sydney-headquartered Microsoft Partner with deep expertise across the entire Power Platform stack (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) and enterprise integration. While they service diverse industries, they excel at rapid app development, governance frameworks, and structured enablement (such as "Automation in a Day" workshops) to help internal manufacturing IT teams safely scale low-cadence tools. Learn more via the [Barhead Power Platform Services](https://barhead.com/our-services/power-platform-services/) overview.[[1]](https://www.erpresearch.com/dynamics-partners/australia)[[2]](https://barhead.com/our-services/power-platform-services/)
- **Data#3 / Velrada / Empired (or similar large-tier local enterprise integrators)** — If your Sydney manufacturing plant operates at an enterprise scale requiring rigid multi-site governance, Azure IoT integration for physical shop-floor machinery, and comprehensive change management, larger tier-one Australian Microsoft partners have dedicated local manufacturing practices suited for complex, non-disruptive ERP-adjacent architecture.

To help narrow down which of these consultants fits best, tell me:

- **Which ERP** are you currently running (e.g., SAP, Pronto, Syspro, Epicor, Dynamics)?
- **What is your primary bottleneck** right now (manual data re-entry from customer emails/PDFs, paper-based shop floor tracking, or siloed inventory reporting)?
